newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chinese farm delegation missing in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Chinese farm delegation missing in Japan.

text.p: Japanese police said on Thursday they were searching for six members of a Chinese regional farm delegation who have been missing since early March.

Police in Yamagata, northern Japan, said the six Chinese farm and livestock experts from Heilongjian Province were last seen boarding a train headed for Tokyo at Yamagata city's main railway station on March 7.
The six arrived in Japan on February 28 and were expected to fly back to China on March 11, police said. Visas for the six expired on March 14.
Oficials of the Foreign Ministry and the Institute for Japan-China Friendship who hosted them were also searching for the six, police said.
